market_holds: Spot $47.12 (sealed baseline, 2026-11-12 18:09 UTC). The front-expiry straddle implies 9.8%, or about 5.9% for the event net of ordinary volatility. The median of the last 7 prints is 5.2%, the largest +23.3% (Nov 2025). The stock is down 18% over 5 sessions and 19.5% over 20, 47% below its 52-week high. Almost all of that came in one day: 2026-11-09, -15.3% on about 8M shares (about 4x average volume), when the closest rival Ionis cut its full-year Tryngolza guidance from $100-110M to about $50M. Tryngolza had $9M of Q3 sales in its first full quarter of the sHTG launch, and Ionis fell 21-27% (Yahoo bars; IBTimes 2026-11-10). Since then ARWR has drifted flat to down with XBI. The Earnings Whispers preview (2026-11-04, before the Ionis news) has consensus at -$1.59 EPS on $66.3M revenue, mostly collaboration revenue. There is no formal guidance, and that consensus predates the Ionis read-through. Last quarter's REDEMPLO revenue was about $2.4M (FCS only), and management said it would not break out product sales until they are meaningful. The sHTG sNDA is promised before year-end 2026, with a priority review voucher. Positioning: put/call open interest 0.57. Short interest unavailable. Sell-side targets about $97-108 (snapshots as of 2026-11-03, stale against the price).
view: The stock trades on the plozasiran franchise, and above all on sHTG. On Nov 9 it was repriced by the one hard datapoint anyone has on how fast sHTG adoption goes: Ionis's first full sHTG quarter came in at $9M, hampered by payer coverage of about a third of commercial lives at label, medical exceptions and free-drug programs. That is real evidence about the same market and the same payers, not tape noise, so per P6 the drop is largely supported rather than an overshoot to fade. Arrowhead's print can show three things inside the window. First, FCS-only REDEMPLO revenue for Jul-Sep: probably a few million and growing, too small to settle the sHTG question either way. Second, whether the sNDA is filed or on track: expected. Third, management's framing of sHTG pricing, access and differentiation (quarterly dosing, the liver-fat profile, the AP data), which will be upbeat as usual but is not data. Collaboration revenue against the $66M consensus depends on milestone timing, and this stock does not trade on it. After a washed-out peer-driven drop, a relief bid is a little more likely than a further leg down, but the release cannot answer the question that actually caused the drop. So I lean slightly up, with no edge I would bet on.

recommendation.reason: The deciding line is sHTG adoption. The price just re-marked it on the closest peer's own launch data, and this release cannot show sHTG demand because plozasiran is not approved there. The FCS revenue and filing-timing items that can show up are small or expected. There is no dated evidence that one side of the line is more likely than the price holds, so the 65% bar is not met.
recommendation.what_would_flip_it: A disclosed REDEMPLO quarter clearly above Tryngolza's run rate (for example, higher than about $5M with strong script growth), or an sNDA already submitted with priority review accepted, would make a squeeze-like relief rally the likely outcome. Commentary showing payer friction like Ionis's would point the other way.

self_critique: Up case: Arrowhead fell as much as a fifth on a rival's launch execution, and the rival's problems are partly its own (a free-drug program, being first through payers, the liver-fat profile). Arrowhead's FCS growth, a filed sNDA and $1.9B of liquidity could spark a sharp relief rally like the +23% in Nov 2025. Down case: management cannot rebut the sHTG demand data, the collaboration revenue may miss, and the burn of roughly $200M a quarter in R&D stays. Holders who stayed through the 11-09 drop may sell any vague answer. Both cases are plausible and neither is evidenced, which is why I stay at 54.
approach_notes: P6's run-in decomposition was the most useful part: it showed the drop was peer-driven but still substantive, which killed an easy fade thesis. P7's push to estimate the line from its inputs had little to work with here, because the deciding line (sHTG adoption) cannot appear in this release.
